name: Take It From The Top musical theater intensives (Wharton Center)
org: Wharton Center for Performing Arts, Michigan State University
what_you_do: Train in musical theater in a five-day intensive on the MSU campus. The Advanced Workshop is by audition and is open from rising 8th grade through college.
who_can_apply: Five-Day Intensive: rising 5th through 12th grade. Advanced Workshop: rising 8th grade through college, by audition.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: Five-Day Intensive $450 (East Lansing). Advanced Workshop $1,125 with room and board or $775 off campus. Financial aid is available through Arts Within Reach.
deadline_text: The page says more information about summer 2027 is coming soon. No 2027 dates are posted. 2026 prices are shown.
how_to_apply: The sign up link and audition details are not posted yet. Contact Kelly Stuible-Clark, stuible3@whartoncenter.com, (517) 884-3166.
